safety.notice: These results are for reference only. Ingredients vary by restaurant and by how the dish is cooked. This app never tells you a dish is safe. Confirm with the staff before you eat.

onboarding.title: Photograph a menu, see the allergy risks
onboarding.subtitle: Take a photo of a Korean restaurant menu to check ingredients and allergens.
onboarding.step1Body: Take a photo of the menu with your camera.
onboarding.step2Body: See the ingredients and allergens for each dish.
onboarding.step3Body: Show the question card to the staff and confirm before you eat.
onboarding.limitBody: This app never marks a dish as safe. It only separates dishes that may be dangerous from dishes you still need to check.
onboarding.consentAnalysis: I agree that the menu photo I take will be sent to the server for analysis. The image is not kept after analysis.
onboarding.consentLimit: I understand these results are not medical advice and that I must confirm with the restaurant staff before eating.
onboarding.consentRequired: You need to agree to both items to continue.

profile.title: My allergies
profile.subtitle: Your selection is stored only on this device and is never sent to a server for storage.
profile.standardHint: Select everything that applies to you.
profile.customHint: Add ingredients that are not in the 22 standard allergens. Even if the system cannot match them, they still appear on the question card.
profile.customLimit: You can add up to {max} keywords.
profile.retentionHint: Your saved allergy settings are deleted automatically after this period.
profile.emptyWarning: You have not selected any allergies. Every dish will be shown as "Needs check", and the question card will only ask about ingredients.
profile.loadFailed: Could not load the allergen list.

scan.title: Photograph the menu
scan.guideTitle: Fit the whole menu in the frame
scan.guideTip1: Line the menu up inside the rectangular guide.
scan.guideTip3: Check that the text looks sharp.
scan.cameraOnlyHint: The photo is used only for analysis and is not stored on your device.
scan.analyzingHint: Reading the dish names and checking ingredients. This can take up to a minute.
scan.desktopHint: On a desktop browser this opens a file picker instead of the camera. Test on a mobile device.

result.title: Results
result.myAllergiesNone: No allergies selected. Every dish is shown as "Needs check".
result.emptyHint: Take another photo with the whole menu in frame.
result.noResult: No results to show. Please photograph a menu again.

menu.statusDangerHint: Contains an ingredient that matches your allergies.
menu.statusNeedsCheckHint: No matching ingredient was found, but that does not mean it is safe. Confirm with the staff.
menu.ingredientsEmpty: No ingredient information was found. Please confirm with the staff.
menu.detectedEmpty: No allergens detected. That does not mean it is safe.

questionCard.title: Screen to show the staff
questionCard.brightnessHint: Turn your screen brightness up before showing this to the staff.

INVALID_IMAGE_OR_NOT_MENU.title: We could not read the menu
INVALID_IMAGE_OR_NOT_MENU.message: Avoid glare and camera shake, and line the menu up inside the guide.

UNSUPPORTED_MEDIA_TYPE.title: Unsupported file type
UNSUPPORTED_MEDIA_TYPE.message: Only JPEG, PNG, WEBP and HEIC images can be analyzed. Please take another photo.

INVALID_ALLERGY_ID.title: Please set your allergies again
INVALID_ALLERGY_ID.message: Your saved allergy settings no longer match the server.

AI_TIMEOUT.title: Analysis is taking too long
AI_TIMEOUT.message: Please try again in a moment.

AI_PROVIDER_ERROR.title: Analysis failed
AI_PROVIDER_ERROR.message: Please try again in a moment.

RATE_LIMITED.title: Too many requests
RATE_LIMITED.message: Please wait a moment and try again.

NETWORK.title: Cannot reach the network
NETWORK.message: Check your internet connection and try again.

TIMEOUT.title: The request timed out
TIMEOUT.message: Check your connection and take another photo.

UNKNOWN.title: Something went wrong
UNKNOWN.message: Please try again in a moment.
